rules.title: Ban on landlord use of coordinated pricing algorithms to set rents or occupancy
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use a coordinated pricing algorithm, meaning one that uses nonpublic competitor data less than 90 days old, to set rents or occupancy levels for residential units in Berkeley. Each month and each unit is a separate violation.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation (per unit per month)
rules.coverage_conditions: All landlords of residential dwelling units in the City of Berkeley.
rules.exemptions: Excluded tools: aggregated or anonymous reports that do not recommend rents or terms; tools for setting affordable housing rent or income limits; and market research for project financing, appraisals, or software research, testing or training.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only where the landlord uses an algorithm relying on nonpublic competitor data less than 90 days old.

rules.penalty: City Attorney civil action for damages, injunctive relief, restitution and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation. An aggrieved tenant may sue for injunctive relief, damages and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation. Prevailing plaintiffs recover attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful for a landlord to use a coordinated pricing algorithm described
rules.conflict_note: The document shows the ordinance was passed to print on November 18, 2025; the URL indicates second reading/adoption on December 2, 2025. No effective date is stated. Berkeley ordinances typically take effect 30 days after final adoption, so it is presumed in force by 2026-10-01. The ordinance amends an existing BMC Chapter 13.63.

rules.title: Ban on selling or licensing coordinated pricing algorithms to Berkeley landlords
rules.requirement: No one may sell, license or otherwise provide to Berkeley landlords a coordinated pricing algorithm that sets or recommends rents or occupancy levels for Berkeley residential units.
rules.key_value: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation
rules.coverage_conditions: Vendors and providers of coordinated pricing algorithms supplied to City of Berkeley landlords for residential dwelling units in Berkeley.
rules.exemptions: Excluded tools: aggregated or anonymous reports that do not recommend rents or terms; tools for setting affordable housing rent or income limits; and market research for project financing, appraisals, or software research, testing or training.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies to software vendors and providers, not to properties directly.

rules.penalty: City Attorney civil action for damages, injunctive relief, restitution and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, plus attorney's fees if the City prevails.
rules.quoted_span: A. It shall be unlawful to sell, license, or otherwise provide to City of Berkeley
rules.conflict_note: The ordinance was passed to print on November 18, 2025, with adoption apparently on December 2, 2025 per the URL. No effective date is stated, so it is presumed in force by 2026-10-01.
